display.purpose: Document titles inside note bodies and landing moments. Content only — never UI chrome (The Serif Boundary Rule).

title.purpose: Panel headings, card titles, view headers.

body.purpose: Note and document prose at 15px/1.625, capped at 65–75ch.

ui.purpose: Buttons, menus, list rows — the default 14px instrument size.

dense.purpose: 13px chrome rows only — sidebar tree, view rows, tab labels. Never prose.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked section labels inside documents and metadata group headers. Sparingly.

shadows.name: resting-hint
shadows.purpose: Maximum for in-flow surfaces (composer bars, pinned headers). Rare.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns and menus — layers that detach from the page.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default for hover, focus, press, selection. Never decorative; always a reduced-motion alternative.

motion.name: collapse
motion.purpose: Sidebar section fold/unfold via grid-template-rows. Suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single ink-blue action on a surface — approve, run, save.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.7rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.45 0.08 270)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.45 0.08 270)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, oklch(0.45 0.08 270)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.99 0.003 260)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.45 0.08 270)) 90%, var(--foreground, oklch(0.235 0.008 260))); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions: hairline border on paper, steel-wash hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--background, oklch(0.985 0.0025 255)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.235 0.008 260)); border-color: var(--border, oklch(0.9 0.006 255)); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.955 0.005 255)); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Toolbar and row-level actions; invisible until hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.235 0.008 260)); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.955 0.005 255)); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Discard/delete: soft red fill with full-strength red text — never a solid slab.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive, oklch(0.5 0.2 27.325)) 10%, transparent); color: var(--destructive, oklch(0.5 0.2 27.325)); } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive, oklch(0.5 0.2 27.325)) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Input
components.description: 32px text field: hairline border, transparent fill, ink-blue focus.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.9 0.006 255)); border-radius: 0.7rem; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.235 0.008 260)); font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.525 0.012 255)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.45 0.08 270)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.45 0.08 270)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Resting content surface: card-white on paper, hairline ring, no shadow.
components.html:
Decision · 2026-07-14

Ship the After-Meeting flow as MVP1; kill criteria at week 4.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 0.98rem; background: var(--card, oklch(1 0.0015 255)); color: var(--card-foreground, oklch(0.235 0.008 260)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, oklch(0.235 0.008 260)) 10%, transparent); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.625; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, oklch(0.235 0.008 260)) 90%, transparent); }

components.name: Sidebar Row
components.description: Navigation row on the steel surface; active row carries the accent tint.
components.html: InboxDecisionsMeetings
components.css: .ds-sidebar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 8px; background: var(--sidebar, oklch(0.963 0.0045 255)); border-radius: 0.7rem; width: 200px; } .ds-nav-row { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 0.56rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sidebar-foreground, oklch(0.235 0.008 260)); text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: var(--sidebar-accent, oklch(0.93 0.008 255)); } .ds-nav-row:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.45 0.08 270)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-nav-row-active { background: var(--sidebar-accent, oklch(0.93 0.008 255)); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, oklch(0.3 0.01 258)); }

components.name: Workspace Tab Strip
components.description: Browser-style join on the steel chrome: the active tab is paper with hairline top/side borders, its bottom edge bridging into the content surface. Documents and sessions share one tab vocabulary.
components.css: .ds-tabstrip { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2px; padding: 6px 8px 0; background: var(--sidebar, oklch(0.963 0.0045 255)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.9 0.006 255)); } .ds-tab { position: relative; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-bottom: none; border-radius: 0.56rem 0.56rem 0 0; background: transparent; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.525 0.012 255)); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-tab:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, oklch(0.235 0.008 260)) 5%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.235 0.008 260)); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.45 0.08 270)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--background, oklch(0.985 0.0025 255)); border-color: var(--border, oklch(0.9 0.006 255)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.235 0.008 260)); margin-bottom: -1px; padding-bottom: 1px; }

components.name: Amber Flag Chip
components.description: The Amber Flag Rule made visible: staleness and inference always render as icon + word in amber, never grey and never color-alone. On the cool field the warm flag cannot be missed.
components.html: inference
components.css: .ds-flag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 0.42rem; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--warning, oklch(0.5 0.11 72)) 15%, transparent); color: var(--warning, oklch(0.5 0.11 72)); font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.025em; }

components.name: Wikilink
components.description: Inline reference chip — the visible fiber of the product memory, inked.
components.css: .ds-prose { font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.235 0.008 260)); margin: 0; } .ds-wikilink { cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0.42rem; padding: 1px 4px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--brand, oklch(0.45 0.08 270)); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--brand, oklch(0.45 0.08 270)) 8%, transparent); transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-wikilink:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--brand, oklch(0.45 0.08 270)) 15%, transparent); } .ds-wikilink-unresolved { color: var(--destructive, oklch(0.5 0.2 27.325)); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive, oklch(0.5 0.2 27.325)) 8%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: Qale is a precision tool whose one color is the color of ink — operator-grade speed and density on a whisper-cool steel ground, with a deep fountain-pen blue carrying every moment of action, selection, and provenance. The metaphor is the product: this is a memory that gets written, and everything the agent touches is marked in ink the PO can read. The accent's depth (L 0.45) and restraint (C 0.08) are what make it ink rather than interface chrome — it must never brighten toward SaaS blue, and the ground must never warm toward cream. The temperament is crisp, fast, operator-grade: compact 32px controls, instant state feedback, keyboard paths everywhere, density where the work is dense. The character lives in the ink voice and the Fraunces serif reserved for document content; the speed lives in everything else. The system explicitly rejects the generic AI-SaaS dashboard — gradient accents, hero metrics, identical card grids, purple-on-dark "AI product" styling — and the cream-paper-plus-orange AI-default look its first palette turned out to be. It equally rejects enterprise Jira grey and refuses to perform: no orchestrated entrances, no decorative motion, no glass. The tool disappears into the task.
keyCharacteristics: One cool steel surface family, one deep ink-blue accent, near-black ink text
Flat surfaces separated by hairline rings and background steps, not shadows
Inter carries all UI; Fraunces appears only inside document content
Compact, quick controls: 32px heights, 1px press-down, 150ms transitions
Provenance-forward: sources, dates, and pending writes are first-class visual citizens

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Ink Blue is the only accent and it means something: action, selection, provenance. It never decorates. If ink blue covers more than ~10% of a screen, something is wrong.

rules.name: The Same-Hue Rule
rules.body: Every neutral sits at hue 255–260, cool and barely tinted. Never introduce a warm grey or a cream-tinted near-white; a warm neutral reads as the AI default this system replaced.

rules.name: The Ink-Stays-Ink Rule
rules.body: The accent never brightens or saturates past its tokens. A lighter, louder blue stops being ink and starts being the default SaaS accent; depth and restraint are the identity.

rules.name: The Amber Flag Rule
rules.body: "Don't trust this yet" is never grey and never color-alone: staleness and inference always render in Amber Flag with an icon and a word. The quietest claim on screen must never be the one that needs verification.

rules.name: The Serif Boundary Rule
rules.body: Fraunces never appears in UI chrome — no serif buttons, labels, menus, or empty states. If it's interactive or part of the instrument, it's Inter.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Rule
rules.body: If it doesn't detach from the page, it doesn't cast a shadow. Cards rest on rings, not shadows.

dos: Do keep every neutral at hue 255–260 (The Same-Hue Rule) and every accent moment ink blue (The One Voice Rule).
Do hit WCAG AA: ≥4.5:1 body contrast (Ink on Paper is ~16:1; Stone is for metadata only), visible focus rings on every interactive element, full keyboard paths.
Do keep transitions 150–250ms, state-driven, with prefers-reduced-motion alternatives.
Do use skeletons for loading content and empty states that teach the interface.
Do show provenance: sources, dates, and pending-write indicators are part of the component, not an afterthought.
donts: Don't build the generic AI-SaaS dashboard: no gradient accents, no hero metrics, no identical card grids, no purple-on-dark "AI product" styling.

Don't let the accent brighten toward SaaS blue (The Ink-Stays-Ink Rule), don't let the neutrals drift warm toward cream, and don't slide into enterprise Jira grey: the cool tint is faint but it is there on purpose.
Don't put shadows on resting surfaces (The Floating-Only Rule) or use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px) as card/callout accents.
Don't use Fraunces anywhere interactive (The Serif Boundary Rule) or uppercase-tracked eyebrows as section scaffolding outside document content.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, decorative motion, or orchestrated page-load choreography — the PO is mid-task; the tool loads into work.
